title: Blue Beetle
about: A recent graduate becomes the host of an alien scarab and his whole family gets dragged in.

Dust with the Tajín.Roughly mash the avocados with the lime juice and a pinch of salt, leaving big chunks.Fold through the onion, tomato, jalapeño and chopped coriander.Pile into a bowl and serve with the warm totopos.Nana's red chilli pork tamalesJaime's Nana and her family recipesHow to make itAs written, serves 4Masa spread on corn husks, filled with pork in red chilli sauce, steamed 90 minutes.Simmer 800g pork shoulder in water with onion and garlic for 2 hours, then shred.Blend 4 soaked guajillo chillies with 2 garlic cloves, cumin and 250ml of the cooking liquid and stir through the pork.Soak 16 corn husks in hot water for 30 minutes.Beat 150g lard or butter until fluffy, then beat in 400g masa harina, 2 tsp baking powder, salt and 500ml warm stock.Spread on the husks, add pork, fold up and steam standing for 90 minutes.Queso fundido with charred poblanoUncle Rudy's recipe, his best invention.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsNana's pozole rojoPork and hominy soup with guajillo chilliHow to make it1kg pork shoulder, cut into pieces1 brown onion4 garlic cloves2 L water4 dried guajillo chillies800g tinned hominy1/4 cabbage4 radishes1 tsp dried oregano2 limesSoak the chillies in hot water. Halve the onion and peel the garlic.Simmer the pork with onion and garlic in the water.Blend the chillies with garlic, stir in with the hominy and simmer.Shred the cabbage and slice the radishes.Serve topped with cabbage, radish, oregano and lime.Graduation carne asada tacosJaime's college graduationHow to make itAs written, serves 4Skirt steak marinated in lime, garlic and orange, grilled and sliced into tacos with salsa.Marinate 800g skirt steak for 2 hours with the juice of 1 orange and 2 limes, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, a handful of chopped coriander and 2 tbsp oil.Grill over very high heat for 3 to 4 minutes a side, rest 5 minutes and slice thinly across the grain.Mix 3 chopped tomatoes, half a diced white onion, 1 chopped jalapeño, coriander and lime for salsa.Serve in 12 warm corn tortillas with salsa and lime wedges.SweetsPan dulce sweet bunsSoft yeast buns with a sweet cocoa crumb toppingHow to make it500g plain flour, for the dough7g dried yeast80g caster sugar, for the dough2 eggs80g butter, for the dough200ml warm milk60g butter, for the topping60g plain flour, for the topping60g caster sugar, for the topping1 tbsp cocoaMix the flour, yeast, sugar, eggs, butter and warm milk for the dough and knead until soft.Prove the dough.Shape into buns.Mix the butter, flour and sugar for the topping with the cocoa into a paste, press a round on each bun and score the top.Prove the buns again.Bake at 180°C.DrinksCinnamon rice horchataChilled rice milk drink with cinnamon, sugar and milkHow to make it200g long grain rice2 cinnamon sticks1 L water100g caster sugar250ml full cream milk1 pinch ground cinnamon1 bag iceSoak the rice and cinnamon sticks in the water overnight.Soak.Blend until smooth and strain through a fine cloth.Stir in the sugar and milk and chill.Pour over ice and top with ground cinnamon.Tamarind agua frescaNana pours, then reaches for the big gun.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
